verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a user-facing scheduler, timer, or recurring workflow capability. Defaults like fstrim and systemd-oomd are mentioned only as system defaults, not as scheduling a user can configure, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
